content: शुद्ध {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [शुध्-क्त] .²1 Pure, clean, purified; अन्तःशुद्धस्त्वमपि भविता वर्णमात्रेण कृष्णः <ls>Me. 51</ls>. .²2 Holy, undefiled, chaste, innocent; अन्वमीयत शुद्धेति शान्तेन वपुषैव सा <ls>R. 15. 77</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 14</ls>. .²3 White, bright. .²4 Stainless, spotless. .²5 Innocent, simple, guileless. .²6 .³({%a%}) Genuine, true. .³({%b%}) Honest, upright. .²7 Correct, faultless, upright. .²8 Cleared, acquitted. .²9 Mere, only; शुद्धं हि दैवमेवेदं हठेनैवास्ति पौरुषम् <ls>Mb. 12. 177. 12</ls>. .²10 Simple, pure, unmixed (<ab>opp.</ab> मिश्र). .²11 Unequalled. .²12 Authorized. .²13 Whetted, sharpened; जघान शुद्धेषुरमन्दकर्षी <ls>Bk. 2. 31</ls>. .²14 Not nasal. .²15 Unmitigated (as capital punishment); तडागभेदकं हन्यादप्सु शुद्धवधेन वा <ls>Ms. 9. 279</ls>. .²16 Tried, examined. .{@-द्धः@} .²1 An epithet of Śiva. .²2 The bright fortnight. .{@-द्धम्@} .²1 Anything pure. .²2 The pure spirit. .²3 Rock-salt. .²4 Black pepper. .²5 A house built generally of one material; namely wood, brick or stone <ab>etc.</ab>; द्रुमेणेष्टकया वापि दृशदाद्यैरथापि वा . एतेन सहितं गेहं शुद्धमित्यभिधीयते <ls>Kāmikāgama. 45. 21</ls>.
